children: Kroger reported second-quarter 2026 results for the period ended August 15, 2026, with total company sales of $34.6 billion and operating profit of $971 million. Adjusted diluted earnings per share were $1.09 for the quarter (vs. $1.04 a year ago) while GAAP diluted EPS was $1.05. The company reaffirmed full-year adjusted EPS guidance of $5.10–$5.30 but lowered identical sales without fuel guidance to 0.2%–0.8%.
Revenue (total company sales): $34.6 billion in 2Q26 (vs. $33.94 billion in 2Q25).
Gross profit: $7,750 million for the quarter; gross margin 22.4% (compared with 22.5% in 2Q25).
Operating profit: $971 million for 2Q26 (compared with $863 million in 2Q25).
Adjusted FIFO operating profit: $1,076 million in 2Q26 (compared with $1,091 million in 2Q25).
Net earnings attributable to Kroger per diluted common share: GAAP $1.05; adjusted diluted EPS $1.09 (vs. $1.04 adjusted in 2Q25).
Identical sales excluding fuel increased 0.2% year-over-year in the quarter; excluding fuel, sale of Vitacost and certain fulfillment center exits, sales rose 0.1%.
eCommerce: Adjusted eCommerce sales grew approximately 20% and Kroger Precision Marketing profit grew 24%, with noted improvement in eCommerce profitability.

Margin drivers: FIFO gross margin rate (ex. rent, D&A, fuel) improved by 13 basis points, supported by better eCommerce profitability, media, favorable pharmacy mix, sourcing initiatives and tariff refunds.

Operational investments and cost management: Company cited planned investments in associate wages, increased healthcare costs, productivity initiatives, and continued share repurchases (year-to-date $1.2 billion repurchased; $800 million remaining authorization).

Capital allocation and liquidity: Kroger expects continued strong free cash flow, reaffirmed quarterly dividend policy (recent 11% increase), and maintains a net total debt to adjusted EBITDA ratio of 1.91 with a target range of 2.30–2.50.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
